repos.description: f.k.a. Awesome ChatGPT Prompts. Share, discover, and collect prompts from the community. Free and open source — self-host for your organization with complete privacy.
repos.summary_zh: prompts.chat 是全球最大的开源提示词库，涵盖 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini 等主流 AI 模型。提供社区驱动的提示词分享与收集平台，支持免费使用及私有化部署，兼具学术引用价值与工业级实用性。
repos.summary_en: Prompts.chat is the world's largest open-source prompt library for AI models like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It offers a community-driven platform to share, discover, and collect prompts, with free public access and self-hosting options for organizations seeking privacy.

repos.description: ⭐AI-driven public opinion & trend monitor with multi-platform aggregation, RSS, and smart alerts.🎯 告别信息过载，你的 AI 舆情监控助手与热点筛选工具！聚合多平台热点 +  RSS 订阅，支持关键词精准筛选。AI 智能筛选新闻 + AI 翻译 +  AI 分析简报直推手机，也支持接入 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 自然语言对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测等。支持 Docker ，数据本地/云端自持。集成微信/飞书/钉钉/Telegram/邮件/ntfy/bark/slack 等渠道智能推送。
repos.summary_zh: TrendRadar 是一款 AI 驱动的舆情监控工具，支持多平台热点聚合、RSS 订阅与智能关键词筛选，提供 AI 翻译与分析简报推送。集成微信/飞书/钉钉等 8+ 通知渠道，支持 Docker 部署与 MCP 架构，赋能 AI 对话分析、情感洞察与趋势预测，30 秒快速部署。
repos.summary_en: TrendRadar is an AI-powered public opinion and trend monitoring tool that aggregates multi-platform hot topics, RSS feeds, and offers smart keyword filtering. It delivers AI-translated analysis briefs via 8+ notification channels (WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, etc.), supports Docker deployment and MCP architecture for AI-driven sentiment analysis and trend forecasting, with a 30-second setup.

repos.description: CowAgent是基于大模型的超级AI助理，能主动思考和任务规划、访问操作系统和外部资源、创造和执行Skills、拥有长期记忆并不断成长。同时支持飞书、钉钉、企业微信应用、微信公众号、网页等接入，可选择OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek/ Qwen/GLM/Kimi/LinkAI，能处理文本、语音、图片和文件，可快速搭建个人AI助手和企业数字员工。
repos.summary_zh: CowAgent 是基于大模型的超级AI助理，支持主动任务规划、多模态交互（文本/语音/图片/文件）、长期记忆与技能系统，可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信、微信公众号等多平台，兼容OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek等主流模型，适用于个人AI助手与企业数字员工场景。
repos.summary_en: CowAgent is a super AI assistant based on large language models, supporting autonomous task planning, multimodal interaction (text/audio/image/files), long-term memory, and a skill system. It integrates with platforms like Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, and WeChat Official Accounts, compatible with OpenAI/Claude/Gemini/DeepSeek models, ideal for personal AI assistants and enterprise digital employees.

repos.summary_zh: WeChatMsg 是一个微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，支持将聊天记录导出为多种格式（如 Excel、HTML），并提供可视化分析功能。项目强调个人数据主权，倡导用户自主管理生活痕迹，未来计划结合 AI 技术构建个人记忆数据中心，实现智能相册与年度报告生成。
repos.summary_en: WeChatMsg is a WeChat chat export and analysis tool that supports exporting chats to formats like Excel and HTML with visualization features. It emphasizes personal data ownership, enabling users to manage their digital footprints. The project aims to integrate AI for building personal memory data centers, including smart photo albums and annual report generation.

repos.description: OpenAssistant is a chat-based assistant that understands tasks, can interact with third-party systems, and retrieve information dynamically to do so.
repos.summary_zh: Open Assistant 是一个开源的聊天式AI助手项目，旨在提供可交互、可集成第三方系统的语言模型服务。项目已完成，核心贡献是构建并发布了 oasst2 高质量对话数据集，推动开放语言模型发展。
repos.summary_en: Open Assistant was an open-source chat-based AI assistant project designed to provide accessible, interactive large language model capabilities with third-party system integration. The project is now completed, with its final oasst2 dataset published on HuggingFace, marking a significant contribution to open-source language model training data.

repos.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
repos.summary_zh: AionUi 是一款免费、开源的 AI 协作者应用，支持 24/7 自动化，内置多 AI 智能体（如 Claude Code、OpenClaw、Qwen Code 等），提供跨平台（macOS/Windows/Linux）本地运行、零配置启动、远程访问（WebUI/Telegram/Lark）和任务调度功能，适用于代码开发、文件处理与自动化工作流。
repos.summary_en: AionUi is a free, open-source AI coworking app that enables 24/7 automation with built-in multi-agent support (e.g., Claude Code, OpenClaw, Qwen Code). It offers zero-setup local execution, cross-platform compatibility, remote access via WebUI/Telegram, and scheduled task automation for coding, file operations, and workflow management.

repos.description: A complete and graceful API for Wechat. 微信个人号接口、微信机器人及命令行微信，三十行即可自定义个人号机器人。
repos.summary_zh: itchat 是一个基于 Python 的微信个人号完整 API，支持微信机器人开发、命令行微信及自动化操作。通过简单代码即可实现消息收发、好友管理、附件下载、群聊处理等功能，支持多开、热重载、命令行二维码显示等高级特性，适合快速构建个性化微信应用。
repos.summary_en: itchat is a complete and elegant Python API for WeChat personal accounts, enabling easy development of WeChat bots, command-line WeChat, and automation. It supports message handling, friend management, file downloads, group chat processing, multi-instance operation, hot reload, and command-line QR code display, ideal for building custom WeChat applications quickly.

repos.description: Conversational RPA SDK for Chatbot Makers. Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/7q8NBZbQzt
repos.summary_zh: Wechaty 是一个对话式 RPA SDK，专为聊天机器人开发者设计，提供跨 WhatsApp、微信等主流消息平台的统一接口，支持 TypeScript、Python、Go 等多语言开发，实现一次编写多平台运行，显著降低聊天机器人开发复杂度。
repos.summary_en: Wechaty is a conversational RPA SDK that simplifies chatbot development by offering a universal interface across messaging platforms like WhatsApp and WeChat. It supports multiple languages including TypeScript and Python, enabling developers to write once and deploy anywhere, streamlining bot creation with open-source ease and community support.

repos.description: 🤖 可 DIY 的 多模态 AI 聊天机器人 | 🚀 快速接入 微信、 QQ、Telegram、等聊天平台 | 🦈支持DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI | 工作流系统、网页搜索、AI画图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话 |
repos.summary_zh: Kirara AI 是一款可自定义的多模态 AI 聊天机器人，支持快速接入微信、QQ、Telegram 等主流聊天平台，兼容 DeepSeek、Grok、Claude、Ollama、Gemini、OpenAI 等主流大模型。具备工作流系统、网页搜索、AI 绘图、人设调教、虚拟女仆、语音对话等功能，提供 WebUI 和 Docker 部署方案。
repos.summary_en: Kirara AI is a customizable multimodal AI chatbot that supports rapid integration with WeChat, QQ, Telegram, and other major messaging platforms. It integrates with leading LLMs including DeepSeek, Grok, Claude, Ollama, Gemini, and OpenAI. Features include workflow systems, web search, AI image generation, persona tuning, virtual maid mode, voice interaction, and offers both WebUI and Docker deployment options.

repos.description: 🚀 Next Gen Multi-tenant AI One-Stop Solution. Builtin Admin & Billing System. Enterprise-Grade Unified LLM Gateway Support for 200+ Models And 35+ Providers, Load Balacing w/ Priority-base Routing, Cost Management, Chat Share, Cloud Sync, Credit/Subscription Billing, All File Parsing, Web Search, Built-in Model Cache.
repos.summary_zh: CoAI.Dev 是一款企业级多租户 AI 一站式解决方案，支持 200+ 模型与 35+ 服务商接入，内置统一 LLM 网关、负载均衡、成本管理与订阅计费系统。具备跨平台 UI、文件解析、Web 搜索、PWA 桌面应用及完整后台管理功能，适用于企业私有化部署与商业化运营。
repos.summary_en: CoAI.Dev is a next-generation multi-tenant AI platform offering unified access to 200+ models across 35+ providers, with built-in billing, load balancing, file parsing, web search, and enterprise-grade admin dashboard. Designed for scalable SaaS deployment and commercial AI service delivery.

repos.description: chat log tool, easily use your own chat data. 聊天记录工具，轻松使用自己的聊天数据
repos.summary_zh: chatlog 是一款聊天记录工具，旨在帮助用户轻松管理和使用自己的聊天数据。由于微信官方函件指出其核心功能存在合规风险，项目于2025年10月20日被主动移除，仅保留说明文件。用户无法再获取代码或支持，建议删除本地副本以规避法律风险。
repos.summary_en: Chatlog was a chat log tool designed to help users easily manage and utilize their own chat data. Due to compliance risks identified in an official letter from WeChat, the project was voluntarily removed on October 20, 2025. Only this notice remains; no code, binaries, or support are available. Users are advised to delete any local copies to avoid legal issues.

repos.description: Use your locally running AI models to assist you in your web browsing
repos.summary_zh: Page Assist 是一款开源浏览器扩展，通过本地运行 AI 模型（如 Ollama）为网页浏览提供智能助手功能。支持 Chrome、Firefox 等主流浏览器，具备侧边栏交互和独立 Web UI 两种使用方式，用户可直接在任意网页中与本地 AI 对话，实现网页内容问答与知识提取。
repos.summary_en: Page Assist is an open-source browser extension that enables interaction with locally running AI models (e.g., via Ollama) directly from any webpage. It offers a sidebar and standalone web UI for Chromium-based browsers like Chrome, Firefox, and Edge, allowing users to chat with webpage content using their own AI model.

repos.description: 消息推送平台🔥 推送下发【邮件】【短信】【微信服务号】【微信小程序】【企业微信】【钉钉】等消息类型。
repos.summary_zh: Austin 是一个企业级统一消息推送平台，支持邮件、短信、微信、钉钉、企业微信等10+渠道的消息下发，具备全链路追踪、资源隔离、定时任务等能力，采用 SpringBoot + Kafka + Redis + Xxl-Job 等技术栈，适用于业务通知、营销触达等场景。
repos.summary_en: Austin is an enterprise-grade unified messaging push platform supporting 10+ channels including email, SMS, WeChat, DingTalk, and enterprise WeChat. It features full-lifecycle tracking, channel isolation, and scheduled delivery via cron. Built with SpringBoot, Kafka, Redis, and Xxl-Job, it serves business notifications and marketing campaigns.

repos.description: 💬 Unofficial WeChat client built with React, MobX and Electron.
repos.summary_zh: weweChat 是基于 React、MobX 和 Electron 开发的非官方微信客户端，支持桌面端多平台运行，具备消息防撤回、桌面通知、键盘快捷键、拖拽发送文件、批量消息发送等实用功能，界面现代化且兼容 macOS 窗口毛玻璃效果。
repos.summary_en: weweChat is an unofficial WeChat desktop client built with React, MobX, and Electron. It supports desktop notifications, message recall blocking, keyboard shortcuts, drag-and-drop file sending, and batch messaging, offering a modern interface with macOS vibrancy effects.

repos.description: 🎒 飞书  ×（GPT-4 + GPT-4V + DALL·E-3 + Whisper）=  飞一般的工作体验  🚀 语音对话、角色扮演、多话题讨论、图片创作、表格分析、文档导出 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 飞书 × OpenAI 深度集成工具，支持 GPT-4、GPT-4V、DALL·E-3 和 Whisper，提供语音对话、图片生成、表格分析、角色扮演等功能，无缝嵌入飞书生态，支持多场景 AI 工作流，提升企业协作效率。
repos.summary_en: Feishu OpenAI integrates GPT-4, GPT-4V, DALL·E-3, and Whisper into Feishu, enabling voice chat, image generation, table analysis, role-playing, and more. It enhances enterprise collaboration with AI-powered workflows, supporting private deployment, cloud functions, and Docker.

repos.description: 专注批量推送的小而美的工具，目前支持：模板消息-公众号、模板消息-小程序、微信客服消息、微信企业号/企业微信消息、阿里云短信、阿里大于模板短信 、腾讯云短信、云片网短信、E-Mail、HTTP请求、钉钉、华为云短信、百度云短信、又拍云短信、七牛云短信
repos.summary_zh: WePush 是一款专注于批量消息推送的轻量级工具，支持微信公众号、小程序、企业微信、短信平台（阿里云、腾讯云等）及邮件等多种渠道。具备变量消息、定时推送、用户导入、多账号管理等功能，提供可视化界面与推送历史管理，适用于营销通知、系统告警等场景。
repos.summary_en: WePush is a lightweight tool for bulk message pushing, supporting WeChat official accounts, mini-programs, enterprise accounts, SMS platforms (e.g., Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud), and email. It offers variable messaging, scheduled delivery, user import, multi-account management, and a user-friendly GUI, ideal for marketing alerts and system notifications.

repos.description: 🌊 AChat - An open-source/self-hosted/local-first AI platform, designed for enterprises and teams, perfectly combining powerful local processing capabilities with seamless remote synchronization.
repos.summary_zh: AChat 是一个开源、自托管的企业级 AI 协作平台，支持本地化处理与远程同步，提供用户管理、支付集成、内容过滤等全套功能，适用于团队和组织内部 AI 应用部署。
repos.summary_en: AChat is an open-source, self-hosted AI platform designed for enterprises and teams, combining local processing with remote synchronization. It offers user management, payment integration, and content filtering out of the box.

repos.description: 🚀 DeepSeek-V3 & R1大模型逆向API【特长：良心厂商】（官方贼便宜，建议直接走官方），支持高速流式输出、多轮对话，联网搜索，R1深度思考，零配置部署，多路token支持，仅供测试，如需商用请前往官方开放平台。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供 DeepSeek-V3 和 R1 大模型的逆向 API 接口，支持高速流式输出、多轮对话、联网搜索及深度思考功能，兼容 ChatGPT 接口标准，支持零配置部署与多账号 token 负载均衡，仅限个人测试使用，商用请转官方平台。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a reverse-engineered API for DeepSeek-V3 and R1 models, featuring high-speed streaming output, multi-turn conversations, web search, and deep reasoning. It is fully compatible with ChatGPT's API interface, supports zero-configuration deployment and multi-token load balancing, intended only for personal testing, commercial use requires official platform access.

repos.description: ChatMCP is an AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
repos.summary_zh: ChatMCP 是一款跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，完整实现 Model Context Protocol (MCP)，支持 MacOS、Windows、Linux、iOS、Android 和 Web 多端运行。提供本地存储、数据同步、LaTeX 渲染、Mermaid 图表生成、HTML 预览及多 LLM 模型接入等功能，适用于智能对话与工具集成场景。
repos.summary_en: ChatMCP is a cross-platform AI chat client implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP), supporting MacOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and Web. It offers local storage, data sync, LaTeX rendering, Mermaid diagram generation, HTML preview, and multi-LLM provider integration for intelligent conversations and tool workflows.

repos.description: 🎒 钉钉 & 🤖 GPT-3.5 让你的工作效率直接起飞 🚀 私聊群聊方式、单聊串聊模式、角色扮演、图片创作 🚀
repos.summary_zh: 基于Go语言开发的钉钉ChatGPT机器人，集成GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini模型，支持私聊、群聊、角色扮演、图片生成等功能，提供Docker部署和Azure-OpenAI支持，显著提升办公沟通效率。
repos.summary_en: A Go-based ChatGPT bot integrated with DingTalk, supporting GPT-3.5/4/4o-mini models, featuring private/group chat, role-playing, image generation, and Azure-OpenAI compatibility via Docker deployment for enhanced workplace productivity.

repos.description: 《面向开发者的 ChatGPT 提示词工程》非官方版中英双语字幕 Unofficial subtitles of "ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers"
repos.summary_zh: 该项目为非官方中英双语字幕，涵盖吴恩达与 OpenAI 开发者合著的《ChatGPT 提示工程》课程，重点讲解面向开发者的 Prompt 编写技巧，包括文本分类、摘要、翻译、聊天机器人构建等 9 个实战章节，配套交互式 Notebook 与 B 站视频，助力开发者掌握高杠杆 AI 技能。
repos.summary_en: This project provides unofficial bilingual Chinese-English subtitles for Andrew Ng and OpenAI's 'ChatGPT Prompt Engineering for Developers' course, covering 9 practical chapters on prompt writing, including text classification, summarization, translation, and chatbot development, with interactive notebooks and Bilibili videos to help developers master this high-leverage AI skill.

repos.description: A local-first AI chat workspace for models, agents, skills, plugins, search, RAG, voice, memory, and artifacts.
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: Markdown 批量导出工具、开放式跨平台博客解决方案，随意组合写作平台(语雀/Notion/FlowUs/飞书/我来Wolai)和博客平台(Hexo/Vitepress/Halo/Confluence/WordPress等)
repos.summary_zh: Elog 是一个开放式跨平台博客解决方案，支持将语雀、Notion、飞书等写作平台与 Hexo、VitePress、WordPress 等博客平台自由组合。它通过 Markdown 批量导出和图床上传功能，打通内容创作与发布的壁垒，提供灵活的文档处理适配器与插件生态，满足开发者与内容创作者的多场景需求。
repos.summary_en: Elog is an open-source cross-platform blogging solution that enables flexible integration between writing platforms (e.g., Notion, Yuque, Feishu) and blog engines (e.g., Hexo, VitePress, WordPress). It supports bulk Markdown export, image hosting via multiple cloud providers, customizable adapters, and extensible plugins to streamline content publishing workflows.

repos.description: Deploy your private Gemini application for free with one click, supporting Gemini 1.5, Gemini 2.0 models.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini Next Chat 是一个开源的 Gemini AI 聊天框架，支持一键免费部署私有应用，兼容 Gemini 1.5/2.0 系列模型。基于 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 构建，提供 Web、桌面多端支持，具备函数调用扩展能力，适用于企业级私有化部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Gemini Next Chat is an open-source, extensible chatbot framework for Gemini AI models (1.5/2.0). Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS, it enables one-click free deployment of private web applications across Web, MacOS, Windows, and Linux platforms with function calling support.

repos.description: 极简且免费的微信消息推送服务 (基于golang)
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Golang 开发的极简免费微信消息推送服务，支持 Docker 一键部署（镜像仅 2MB），提供每日 10 万次推送额度，支持原生弹窗与声音提醒，具备多用户管理、自定义跳转页面及无限换肤功能，适用于个人及小型项目消息通知场景。
repos.summary_en: A minimalist and free WeChat message push service built with Golang, supporting one-click Docker deployment (2MB image), 100K daily push quota, native pop-up and sound alerts, multi-user support, customizable redirect pages, and unlimited skin switching, ideal for personal and small-scale notification systems.

repos.description: 🚀 一键部署个人的 ChatGPT 镜像站
repos.summary_zh: ChatGPT Mirror 是一个个人 ChatGPT 镜像站，支持多账号共享管理，提供与官网一致的完整功能体验。通过录入 ChatGPT Token 实现团队协作访问，内置 API 接口（/v1/chat/completions）兼容主流客户端，无需翻墙即可使用。支持 Docker 一键部署，含管理后台和临时聊天模式，现已停止维护并推荐迁移至 Grok Mirror。
repos.summary_en: ChatGPT Mirror is a personal ChatGPT mirror site enabling multi-account sharing and management for team collaboration. It delivers full-featured access identical to the official site, with built-in API (/v1/chat/completions) compatible with clients like ChatGPT-Next-Web. No VPN required; supports Docker one-click deployment, admin panel, and ephemeral chat modes. Discontinued; users advised to migrate to Grok Mirror.

repos.description: A more beautiful and easier-to-use alternative to OpenClaw. It features a nicer Web UI, built-in IM support, a sandboxed runtime and channel-based team collaboration. Under the hood, it is powered by a Claude Code–based agent.
repos.summary_zh: Poco 是一款基于 Claude Code 的智能体平台，提供比 OpenClaw 更美观易用的替代方案。核心特性包括安全沙箱环境、多模态文件支持、原生 Claude Code 交互体验（计划模式/提问模式）、内置浏览器与 GitHub 集成、MCP/Skills 扩展能力，以及钉钉/飞书/Telegram 消息集成。采用 Next.js + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker 一键部署和移动端访问。
repos.summary_en: Poco is a safer and more user-friendly alternative to OpenClaw, powered by a Claude Code-based agent. It features a secure sandboxed runtime, native Claude Code experience (Plan Mode, AskQuestion), built-in browser, GitHub integration, MCP/Skills extensibility, IM integrations (DingTalk/Feishu/Telegram), and multilingual support. Built with Next.js + FastAPI, deployable via Docker with mobile access.

repos.description: 一个基于 NextJS + Cloudflare 技术栈构建的可爱消息推送服务, 支持多种消息推送渠道✨
repos.summary_zh: MoePush 是基于 Next.js 和 Cloudflare 构建的开源消息推送服务，支持钉钉、企业微信、Telegram 等 8 种推送渠道，提供简洁的 API 接口与精美 UI，采用 Drizzle ORM 和 D1 数据库，支持 GitHub 登录与 Docker 部署，适合快速集成多平台消息通知。
repos.summary_en: MoePush is an open-source message push service built with Next.js and Cloudflare, supporting 8+ channels including DingTalk, WeCom, and Telegram. It offers a clean API, shadcn/ui-based UI, GitHub OAuth, D1 database via Drizzle ORM, and Docker deployment for easy multi-platform notification integration.

repos.description: 可商业化的 AI Web 平台，提供一站式人工智能服务解决方案。支持私有化部署，内置多用户管理，适合企业、团队或个人快速构建 AI 服务。
repos.summary_zh: 99AI 是一个可商业化的 AI Web 平台，提供一站式人工智能服务解决方案。支持私有化部署与多用户管理，集成 AI 对话、深度思考、联网搜索、智能图表生成及自定义应用广场等功能，适用于企业、团队或个人快速构建商业化 AI 服务。
repos.summary_en: 99AI is a commercializable AI web platform offering an all-in-one AI service solution. It supports private deployment, multi-user management, and integrates features like AI chat, deep thinking models, web search, intelligent diagram generation, and customizable agent apps for rapid enterprise or team AI service development.

repos.description: 🦄 The world's largest Midjourney drawing API, generating over 1 million drawings daily, supporting Discord Youchuan Midjourney 🐂！
repos.summary_zh: Midjourney API 是全球最大的 Midjourney 绘图 API 代理项目，日生成图像超百万张，完全免费开源。支持 Discord 绘图、悠船绘图及官网接入，提供 Imagine、Vary、Remix 等全套指令，集成账号池管理、多数据库支持、负载均衡、CloudFlare 验证绕过、图片/视频一键换脸等功能，适用于企业级绘图服务部署。
repos.summary_en: Midjourney API is the world's largest free and open-source proxy for Midjourney's Discord channel, generating over 1 million images daily. It supports full-featured drawing via Discord, YouChuan, and official Midjourney, with comprehensive commands like Imagine, Vary, Remix, account pooling, load balancing, CloudFlare bypass, image/video face swap, and enterprise-grade deployment features.

repos.description: A Telegram bot with a silky smooth AI experience. UI enabled.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个功能强大的 Telegram AI 聊天机器人，支持 Azure OpenAI 和原生 OpenAI API，提供实时流式响应与 DALL·E 3 图像生成。具备多角色预设、用户分级权限、一键清空对话、容器化部署等特性，界面支持中英文切换，用户体验流畅顺滑。
repos.summary_en: A high-performance Telegram bot delivering seamless AI interactions via OpenAI and Azure OpenAI APIs, featuring real-time streaming responses, DALL·E 3 image generation, customizable bot personas, user tiered access control, and containerized deployment with bilingual UI support.

repos.description: OpenAI 接口聚合管理，我们致力于提供优质的API接入服务，让您可以轻松集成先进的AI模型至您的产品和服务。
repos.summary_zh: Chat API 是基于 One API 和 New API 二次开发的 OpenAI 接口聚合管理系统，提供多模型接入、令牌分组计费、渠道标签化管理及 WxPusher 推送通知等功能，支持 Docker/宝塔一键部署，适用于企业级 AI 服务集成。
repos.summary_en: Chat API is a secondary development of One API and New API, serving as an OpenAI interface aggregation management system. It offers multi-model access, token-based billing, channel tagging, WxPusher notifications, and supports Docker/Baota one-click deployment for enterprise-level AI service integration.

repos.description: 微信4.x数据解密并生成年度总结，高仿微信，支持实时更新，导出聊天记录，朋友圈等大量便捷功能
repos.summary_zh: 微信4.x数据解密与分析工具，支持聊天记录、朋友圈解密与可视化，提供高仿微信界面的年度总结生成、实时更新、搜索及导出功能，涵盖联系人管理与多消息类型展示。
repos.summary_en: WeChat 4.x data decryption and analysis tool with chat history, Moments decryption, annual summary generation, real-time updates, search, export, and contact management features, featuring a WeChat-like interface.

repos.description: 微信聊天记录导出、分析工具
repos.summary_zh: Wechat Explorer 是一款专为 iOS 设备设计的微信聊天记录导出与分析工具，通过解析 iTunes 备份中的微信数据，支持导出聊天室记录、统计好友标签及聊天室活跃度，并可生成 HTML 报告转为 PDF，适用于个人数据备份与社交行为分析。
repos.summary_en: Wechat Explorer is an iOS-focused tool for exporting and analyzing WeChat chat records by parsing iTunes backups. It supports exporting chatroom logs, generating friend label statistics, and creating PDF reports from HTML exports, ideal for personal data archiving and social behavior insights.

repos.description: Local-first multi-AI group chat desktop app — pull gpt, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek into one conversation. Tauri 2 + React 19.
repos.summary_zh: Talkio 是一款本地优先的多 AI 群聊桌面应用，支持将 GPT、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek 等模型整合进同一对话。基于 Tauri 2 + React 19 构建，具备身份角色系统、MCP 工具调用、文件解析、流式输出等功能，提供跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux/Android）体验，所有数据加密存储于本地 SQLite，保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: Talkio is a local-first multi-AI group chat desktop app that integrates models like GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek into one conversation. Built with Tauri 2 + React 19, it features persona-based roleplay, MCP tool integration, file parsing, streaming output, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux/Android), with all data encrypted locally in SQLite for privacy.

repos.description: 一个先进的聊天应用，演示了一种独特的对话范式：用户的查询首先由两个不同的人工智能角色进行辩论和提炼，然后才提供最终的综合答案。该项目利用 Google Gemini API 驱动一个逻辑型 AI (Cognito) 和一个怀疑型 AI (Muse)，它们协作生成更健壮、准确和经过严格审查的响应。
repos.summary_zh: Dual AI Chat 是一个基于 React 19 的先进聊天应用，创新性地引入双 AI 协作范式：逻辑型 Cognito 与创意型 Muse 通过内部辩论提炼答案，结合 Google Gemini 深度思考模型，提供更高准确性、全面性和严谨性的综合响应。
repos.summary_en: Dual AI Chat is an advanced chat application built with React 19 that introduces a novel dual-AI collaboration paradigm. It leverages two distinct AI personas—Cognito (logical) and Muse (creative)—to debate and refine responses, enhanced by Google Gemini's deep thinking capabilities for more accurate, comprehensive, and rigorously vetted answers.

repos.description: A multi-model AI Telegram bot powered by Cloudflare Workers, supporting various APIs including OpenAI, Claude, and Azure. Developed in TypeScript with a modular design for easy expansion.基于 Cloudflare Workers 的多模型 AI Telegram 机器人，支持 OpenAI、Claude、Azure 等多个 API，采用 TypeScript 开发，模块化设计便于扩展。
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Cloudflare Workers 的多模型 AI Telegram 机器人，支持 OpenAI、Claude、Azure 等多个 API，采用 TypeScript 开发，模块化设计便于扩展。具备智能对话、图像生成与分析、多语言支持等功能，通过 Redis 缓存提升性能，适用于构建高效可扩展的 AI 聊天服务。
repos.summary_en: A multi-model AI Telegram bot built with TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, supporting APIs from OpenAI, Claude, Azure, and more. Features modular architecture for easy expansion, including intelligent conversation, image generation/analysis, multilingual support, and Redis caching for high-performance deployment.

repos.summary_zh: 为 Windows 平台打造的 Claude Code 原生聊天界面扩展，提供现代化 UI 和自定义 API 支持，兼容 VS Code 和 Cursor，支持第三方 API 接入，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: A native Windows UI extension for Claude Code that enhances the CLI experience with a modern chat interface, custom API support, and seamless integration with VS Code/Cursor for improved developer productivity.

repos.description: AI Chat / Search / Notes / Collaboration / Channels / Cloud Drive, all in one place! - Collaborative AI Platform.
repos.summary_zh: Nya AI 是一个集成 AI 聊天、网页搜索、笔记记录、文档协作、团队沟通与云端存储的一体化智能协作平台。其核心优势在于以 AI 为中心的交互设计，支持多分支对话、文件解析、MCP 扩展、多模态输入输出及实时云同步，提供接近本地应用的流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: Nya AI is an integrated collaborative platform combining AI chat, web search, note-taking, document writing, team communication, and cloud storage. Its core strength lies in AI-centric design with features like message branching, file parsing, MCP integration, multimodal I/O, and real-time cloud sync via Zero, delivering a local-first-like experience across devices.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级、专注国产生态的 AI 助手框架，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、通义千问等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供统一的 Function Calling 能力。它原生集成 QQ、飞书、钉钉、企业微信等通讯平台适配器，内置 25 个工具（文件操作、浏览器自动化、定时任务等）、记忆系统、Skills 技能扩展机制，以及智能上下文压缩策略，适用于企业内部机器人和团队协作场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework focused on the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, and Qwen via unified OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible interfaces with native Function Calling. It integrates adapters for QQ, Feishu, DingTalk, and WeCom, featuring 25 built-in tools (file ops, browser automation, cron jobs), memory system, Skills extension via SKILL.md, and intelligent context compression—ideal for enterprise bots and team collaboration.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级 AI 助手框架，专为国产生态设计，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、Qwen 等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供飞书、钉钉、QQ、企业微信等多平台机器人接入，具备 Function Calling、25 个内置工具、记忆系统、定时任务等核心功能，代码简洁（约1.6万行），适合学习 Agent 原理和快速开发企业级智能助手。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework designed for the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, Qwen, and OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs. It offers multi-platform bot integration (Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, WeCom), native Function Calling, 25 built-in tools, memory system, cron jobs, and a skill-based architecture. With ~16K lines of clean code, it's ideal for learning agent principles and rapid development of enterprise-grade AI assistants.

repos.description: 让 Z.ai Chat 物尽其用
repos.summary_zh: zai-proxy 是一个 Go 语言开发的代理服务，将 z.ai 网页聊天接口转换为 OpenAI API 和 Anthropic Messages API 兼容格式。支持 GLM 及 Claude 模型自动映射、流式响应、多模态输入、函数调用、联网搜索等高级功能，提供匿名 token 免登录访问，支持 Docker 部署和自定义代理池配置。
repos.summary_en: zai-proxy is a Go-based proxy service that transforms z.ai web chat into OpenAI and Anthropic API-compatible formats. It supports model mapping (GLM/Claude), streaming responses, multimodal inputs, function calling, search mode, anonymous access, Docker deployment, and custom proxy pools for enhanced reliability.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

repos.description: claudeclaw
repos.summary_zh: MateCode 是一个通过 Telegram 远程控制 Claude Code 的桥接工具，支持长期记忆、会话管理、代码高亮等功能。采用纯 Python 标准库开发，基于长轮询实现低延迟通信，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: MateCode is a bridge tool that enables remote control of Claude Code via Telegram, featuring long-term memory, session management, and code highlighting. Built with pure Python standard libraries, it uses long polling for low-latency communication with local SQLite storage for privacy.

repos.description: 油猴 chatgpt Prompt 脚本插件，在chatgpt聊天框导入Prompt 对话框
repos.summary_zh: 该油猴脚本为 ChatGPT 网页端提供中文 Prompt 训练对话框插件，支持一键导入预设角色提示词，提升交互效率。基于 GreasyFork 部署，集成 Docusaurus 搜索功能并优化 PC 端中文输入延迟问题。强调使用英文提示词以获得更稳定输出，建议添加 'respond in Chinese' 控制回复语言。
repos.summary_en: A Tampermonkey script that adds a Chinese Prompt training dialog to ChatGPT's web interface, enabling one-click import of role-based prompts for enhanced productivity. Hosted on GreasyFork with Docusaurus-powered search, it addresses PC-side input lag via debounce. Recommends English prompts for reliability and supports language control via 'respond in Chinese'.

repos.description: 为你的赛博招魂幡 Skill 提供一个赛博酒吧🍺
repos.summary_zh: SkillBar 是一个基于 Claude AI 的交互式技能群聊平台，支持用户上传自定义 Skill.md 文件创建虚拟人物角色，并让这些角色在群聊中自由讨论、分享见解。项目采用 Node.js + SQLite 架构，提供本地开发、Docker 部署等多种运行方式，适用于知识问答、创意激发和跨领域思维碰撞等场景。
repos.summary_en: SkillBar is an interactive AI chat platform powered by Claude that allows users to upload custom Skill.md files to create virtual personas, enabling them to engage in dynamic group discussions. Built with Node.js and SQLite, it supports local development, Docker deployment, and is ideal for knowledge sharing, creative brainstorming, and cross-domain thinking.

repos.description: 一个发布 Telegram 翻译的 Bot
repos.summary_zh: Telegram-cn-l10n-bot 是一个用于发布 Telegram 中文翻译的自动化 Bot，支持通过命令上传和管理 Android、iOS、桌面端语言文件。用户发送语言文件获取 file_id 后，使用 /setandroid、/setios、/setdesktop 命令绑定文件槽，实现多平台翻译包的高效分发。
repos.summary_en: Telegram-cn-l10n-bot is an automated bot for publishing Telegram Chinese translations. It allows users to upload language files via commands (/setandroid, /setios, /setdesktop) using file_id, enabling efficient distribution of localized packages across platforms.

repos.description: 🔍 多平台热门新闻聚合工具，自动推送你关注的新闻 - 自媒体微信公众号等新闻类文章辅助工具，支持今日头条、百度热搜、微博、抖音、知乎、B 站、财联社等11个中文热门平台，分析关键词频率，生成报告并支持多渠道手机推送等。持续追踪热点变化。😊欢迎通过 star ⭐支持开发者，😎为伟大的开源事业添砖加瓦，已支持企业微信，飞书，钉钉，telegram的推送渠道(晚点支持docker
repos.summary_zh: TrendRadar 是一个多平台热门新闻聚合工具，支持今日头条、微博、抖音等11个中文主流平台，自动抓取并分析关键词频率生成热点报告。提供企业微信、飞书、钉钉、Telegram等多渠道推送，具备轻量部署、实时追踪和AI智能分析能力，助力用户高效获取精准资讯。
repos.summary_en: TrendRadar is a multi-platform hot news aggregation tool supporting 11 major Chinese platforms like Toutiao, Weibo, and Douyin. It automatically collects news, analyzes keyword frequency to generate trend reports, and delivers updates via WeCom, Feishu, DingTalk, Telegram, and more. Features include lightweight deployment, real-time tracking, and AI-powered insights for efficient information filtering.
